name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: GDACS orange alert for Cyclone Akvan in the Bay of Bengal; IMD expects landfall in Andhra Pradesh by noon on 20 Nov
state: GDACS issued an orange alert for Tropical Cyclone Akvan, affecting India, at 18:00 UTC on 16 Nov (GDACS). India's Meteorological Department forecast on 16 Nov that it would strengthen into a very severe cyclonic storm and cross the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Tuni by noon on 20 Nov, with winds of 120–130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h; orange rain warnings cover southern Odisha districts on 19–20 Nov (The Week). An orange alert sets Watch.
for_you: People in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha should follow India Meteorological Department and state disaster authority warnings. Travellers should check FCDO advice for India.

sources.title: The Week — Severe cyclonic storm Akvan: rainfall warnings for Odisha

why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
